payloads.name: ps5-exporter
payloads.description: The console's temperatures, power, fan, clocks, CPU load, frame rate and running game as Prometheus metrics on port 9100. ps5-homeassistant reads them.
payloads.author: Marice

payloads.name: ps5-homeassistant
payloads.description: The PS5 as a device in Home Assistant over MQTT: its values from ps5-exporter, live events (trophies, games started and stopped, ShadowMountPlus copies), the status of your payloads, starting a game, a notification on the TV, the light and beeper through ps5-signal, rest mode and power off.
payloads.author: Marice

payloads.name: ps5-signal
payloads.description: Beeps and the console's light for you and for homebrew: a startup tune, colours, patterns, over a small HTTP API on the console.
payloads.author: Marice

payloads.name: ps5-smbd
payloads.description: The console's /data and /mnt as Windows shares (SMB2/3): \\<console name>\data, read and write, login ps5 / ps5. Anyone on your network who knows that login can change or delete anything there.
payloads.author: Marice
